auth_methods.quote: You can use either HTTP Basic Authentication or Bearer Authentication.
auth_methods.note: API key (own account) and OAuth 2 access token (other users' accounts); both sent via HTTP Basic (anystring:token) or Bearer header.

credential_access.quote: To use the Marketing API, you need a Mailchimp account.
credential_access.note: Account creation is self-serve; docs say capabilities depend on plan level but do not state a paid plan is required to get an API key (free plan access inferred from account-only requirement).

production_gate.quote: It's also a requirement for listing an integration in the Mailchimp Marketplace.
production_gate.note: OAuth apps are self-registered on the Registered Apps page; marketplace listing is optional (only for being listed), not required to be installable by users.

api_type.quote: The Marketing API generally follows REST conventions, with some deviations.
api_type.note: OpenAPI-described REST. A CLI and SDKs exist but are wrappers.

mcp_official.quote: Connect Mailchimp to Claude to build marketing campaigns, generate omnichannel strategies, and manage your workflows through a simple conversation.
mcp_official.note: Vendor-run Mailchimp connector (ai-inc.mailchimp.com/claude/mcp/v2) in Claude directory; developer docs also host a docs-search MCP server (not account actions).

main_blocker_type.quote: An API key authenticates requests against your own Mailchimp account.
main_blocker_type.note: Self-serve keys and OAuth app registration, no review gate.
